references.text: Parallel text describing how the tribe of Judah also failed to drive out the Jebusites from Jerusalem, and that they continued to live there alongside the people of Judah.
David finally conquered Jerusalem from the Jebusites, showing the fulfillment of what was predicted in Judges that the Jebusites lived there 'to this day'.
Jerusalem is mentioned as part of the inheritance allotted to the tribe of Benjamin, explaining why it was the responsibility of Benjamin's sons to drive out the Jebusites.
Parallel account of David's conquest of Jerusalem from the Jebusites, marking the end of their settlement in the city.
Describes Judah's earlier attack on Jerusalem, but despite this, they were unable to permanently drive out the Jebusites.
